$X'\to X$ in a category $\mathcal C$ with finite fibre products over $X$; $X'^{I}$ = cartesian power over $X$ ($I$ finite set).
F=F_M\colon B\mapsto M_B=M\otimes_AB;\qquad F(K_\bullet)\ \text{a cosimplicial object of abelian groups}

If $X'\to X$ has a section (a homomorphism $A'\to A$ composing to $\mathrm{id}_A$ with $A\to A'$): $\check H^i=0$ for $i\ge1$ and $\varepsilon$ is an isomorphism (homotopy equivalence of the simplicial objects).
Constant cochain complex: differentials alternately $0$, $\mathrm{id}$, $0,\dots$; cohomology $M$ in degree $0$ only.
$A'/A$ faithfully flat: take $B=A'$; the diagonal $B'\to B$ gives a section, so $H^i=0$ ($i\ge1)$ and $M\xrightarrow{\sim}H^0$.
x\otimes1=0\in M\otimes A'\ \Rightarrow\ f_i^nx=0\ \forall i;\qquad \sum g_if_i^n=1\ \Rightarrow\ x=0
Hence $\widetilde M$ is a sheaf and affine schemes are acyclic for $\widetilde M$: $H^i(\operatorname{Spec}A,\widetilde M)=0$, $i>0$.

$M$ of finite presentation: flat $\iff$ projective of finite type $\iff$ $\widetilde M$ locally free (a vector bundle). Over $\mathbb C$: $\widetilde M$ locally free iff the analytic sheaf on $X^{an}$ is.
